message:
As someone who loves being prepared (maybe a little too much sometimes!), I find it incredibly helpful to have resources on hand that cover all bases, especially when it comes to home safety. Fire safety can feel a bit overwhelming, but breaking it down into manageable steps makes it a lot easier to tackle. From creating a fire escape plan to understanding how to use a fire extinguisher, there’s so much we can do to keep our homes safe and sound. 

It's all about being gloriously over-prepared, right? 😄 I'd love to hear your tips or tricks for fire safety around the home!
